study: How image structure affects clothing classification
audit_revision: Corrective rerun after v1 test results were inspected. Same hypothesis, models, seeds, tuning grid and pixel-distance thresholds. The near-duplicate scan now covers all pairs without a hash filter or bucket cap.
hypothesis: Local spatial relationships in clothing images help distinguish shapes. A small CNN should outperform the MLP on intact images, but lose that advantage, potentially reversing their order, after a shared fixed pixel permutation.
